name: Scenario 3D OS (open-source agent skills for a full 3D pipeline)
summary: MIT-licensed Agent Skills repo from Scenario that gives Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents ~80 skills across animation, art, modeling, look dev, worlds and pipeline (rigging, video-to-motion, image-to-3D, PBR retexturing, skyboxes/splats, retopo/UV, engine-ready export), plus expert skill teams that drive local Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, Unity, Godot and Roblox Studio.

access.price: Skills $0 (MIT); Scenario generation: 50 free daily credits, plans $15/$45/$75 per month
access.notes: Skills are free; generation skills call the Scenario MCP and need a Scenario account (free tier 50 credits/day, no card). DCC/engine expert skills need only the local app (Blender, Maya, Unreal...).

procedure: Install all Scenario skills: npx skills add scenario-labs/skills (pick groups in the menu) or a single one with --skill <name>.
For generation skills, connect the Scenario MCP: claude mcp add --transport http scenario https://mcp.scenario.com/mcp, then sign in with a Scenario account (free tier available).
For expert tools (Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, Unity, Godot, Roblox), install the family from its README in skills/dcc or skills/game-engines; they drive the app installed on your machine.
Optional: pin a reviewed release with npx skills@1.7.4 add scenario-labs/skills#<commit>.

stats.count: 174 SKILL.md files (~80 skills in the 3D OS set)

verdict.why: Official first-party open-source release (MIT, ~2k stars, 1k+ likes on launch) that wires agents into real 3D/game DCCs and engines; DCC/engine skills run free and local, generation part is freemium via Scenario credits.
